steps: Get your referral code in Web Branch.
Share the code with a friend who wants to join UW Credit Union.
Friend uses the code when they open their checking account.
timing: Bonus for both parties when the friend opens the checking account with the referral code; no exact posting date stated.
when_cash_arrives: Bonus for both parties when the friend opens the checking account with the referral code; no exact posting date stated. Paid after your friend completes the program's activity requirements - the friend's qualification is the gating step.
maximize: Have your friend knock out transaction counts in a single day (small purchases) and set up direct deposit on the first paycheck - do not let activity dribble across the window.
Verify the exact qualification checklist with the institution before referring - thin-terms programs often have unpublished requirements that void referrals.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: you only get paid if the friend completes real banking activity; a join-and-idle referral earns nothing.
